paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 15; he disagreed with R' Yochanan and R' Shimon ben Lakish.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ורש״בל is read contextually as and R' Shimon ben Lakish, with the title component left unexpanded. The other personal title abbreviations likewise remain R'. The source reports disagreement, without a generational inference.

ויק״ר ספ״טו gives Vayikra Rabbah, end of chapter 15, without independent named-edition verification. Older machine בפ״טו/חולק/יו differ from supplied ספ״טו/חלק/יוחנן; they are not new printed alternatives.
